features.title: Barbers
features.body: Profiles, portfolios, services and weekly schedules; a barber can work part-time at several shops.

features.title: Shops
features.body: Facility fees, weekly rent and product tiers, with ratings and tips for the shop itself.

features.title: Booking & payment
features.body: Live slots, a deposit or full payment, and conflict-safe booking so a slot is never double-sold.

features.title: Find a barber from a short
features.body: Watch a 15-second cut, then book the same slot at whichever shop they work in that day.

features.title: Creator commissions
features.body: If your short sent the booking, you earn a commission.

features.title: 0% fees, no server
features.body: Accounts, bookings and shorts live on decentralised infrastructure; money moves directly between people.
